gridui-02: Pane shell header and tabs. RETIRED as obsolete 2026-10-19.

── Findings (verified in code 2026-10-19) ──
The pane shell got its header slot and corner brackets built INTO the Pane widget (FrameStyle::Bracketed; widgets/pane/mod.rs) — T091 and T093 done there.
